card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: Mostly the later pieces of invented brand drug names written in capitals, such as the EO in VEOPOZ or the AN in STEGLUJAN. Also fires on a few small words like 'to' or 'or' in lists of devices or websites.

modes.label: Brand name pieces

modes.label: Linking words in web text
modes.description: A small word like 'to', 'or' or 'PC' in casual text about software, devices or games.
